name: Choir of the Pit
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

abilities.name: Wounded Crescendo
abilities.description: While the choir has half of its hit points or fewer, its Multiattack makes one additional Dirge Note attack.

abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
abilities.description: If the choir fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

abilities.name: Hymn Ward
abilities.description: The choir has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The choir makes two Dirge Note attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of (A) or (B) Spellcasting to cast *Bestow Curse*.

actions.name: Dirge Note
actions.description: *Melee or Ranged Spell Attack:* +9 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) necrotic damage.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.description:
The choir casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): - **At will:** *Bestow Curse*, *Fear*
**1/day each:** *Blight*, *Cloudkill* (level 6 version)

legendary_actions.name: Versicle Strike
legendary_actions.description: The choir makes one Dirge Note attack.

legendary_actions.name: Chorus Drift
legendary_actions.description: The choir moves up to half its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

legendary_actions.name: Keening Reveal
legendary_actions.description: One creature within 30 feet of the choir must succeed on a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the choir until the end of its next turn.

generation.userConcept: a bone-choir that sings the dying into its ranks

other_edition.lore: Born of a choir that died together in a plague-pit, the Choir of the Pit sings on, stealing the dying into its verses and swelling its ranks with every soul it reaps.
